**🆓 Permanently Free Plan** - A generous free tier that lowers the barrier to entry for creators - **📧 Professional Email Marketing** - Built-in email marketing system that directly converts fans into customers - **🛍️ Integrated Store** - One-stop sales for digital products, courses, and booking services ## 🏢 Company Background and Market Position ### Company History and Funding **Founding Background**: Beacons was founded in 2019 with a focus on providing monetization tools for creators, quickly growing into a major player in the creator economy. **Funding Achievements**: - **Product iteration**: Launched AI 2.0, leading industry innovation **The 2025 AI Revolution**: - **Smart content generation**: AI-driven email copywriting and social media content creation - **Smart data analytics**: Automated data insights and optimization recommendations -
